EA Sports FC 25 — Where to Buy Digital Cheapest

PlayStation / Xbox · Updated 2026-08-05

EA Sports FC 25 is the latest annual football (soccer) sim from EA, the continuation of the FIFA series. If you play Ultimate Team, this is the year's version you'll want.

Standard vs Ultimate Edition

  • Standard — the base game; enough for career and kick-off modes
  • Ultimate — early access, Ultimate Team coins, and loan players; only worth it for heavy FUT players

Ultimate Team reality check

The "cheapest" copy is irrelevant if you spend on FUT packs. Buy Standard unless you're deep into the mode — the edition upsell mostly feeds microtransactions.

Where to buy digital cheapest

EA's own store and console stores hold price tightly at launch, but third-party key and bundle stores discount FC within a couple of months — previous entries hit half-price fast. Humble's digital store is a reliable place to watch for promos, and it stacks with its usual seasonal sales.

Where to buy

  • Check Humble Bundle
  • Check on Amazon
